story_text:
Welcome to Midnight Mysteries, a Halloween-inspired STL collection from Elysian Studio. Meet Velma, Daphne, Freyra Witch and the Hooded Reaper in a world of haunted televisions, playful monsters and midnight magic.
Explore the characters, alternate sculpts, shared diorama and pumpkin chibi models in the images below. Choose the collection that suits you, from the main cast to the complete release. Every stretch-goal model unlocked during the campaign is included in Core Collection and above.
All rewards are digital STL files for 3D printing. No physical miniatures are shipped. Print, paint and bring your own Midnight Mysteries collection to life.
risks: Preparing digital models for reliable printing can require extra adjustments and testing. If anything affects the delivery schedule, we will keep backers informed through project updates. Rewards will be delivered digitally; no physical products will be shipped. If you have a question or a problem with your files, please contact us through Kickstarter messages.

faq.a: No. This is a digital STL collection for 3D printing. No physical miniatures will be shipped.

faq.q: When will I receive my files?
faq.a: We plan to deliver the digital rewards within 2–3 weeks after the campaign ends. This allows time to confirm pledges and prepare the final files. If the schedule changes, we will keep backers informed through Kickstarter updates.

faq.q: How will I download my rewards?
faq.a: The files will be hosted on Google Drive. We will also provide a convenient web catalogue where you can browse the models and open their download links, similar to the catalogue used for Cursed Tales 2. Backers will receive access to the files included in their selected reward and add-ons.

Core Collection includes the four standard characters: Velma, Daphne, Freyra Witch and the Hooded Reaper. Full Collection adds the three NSFW variants of Velma, Daphne and the Hooded Reaper. Complete Collection adds the shared Velma & Daphne diorama and all three pumpkin chibi models. Merchant Complete includes the Complete Collection with a commercial printing licence. Early Bird and regular versions of each tier contain the same rewards.

faq.q: Are stretch goals included in my reward?
faq.a: Yes. Every stretch-goal model unlocked during this campaign is included in Core Collection and all higher tiers, including their Early Bird versions, at no extra cost. Only goals reached during the campaign are included.

faq.q: How do add-ons work, and do I need them?
faq.a: Add-ons let you expand your selected collection with the NSFW Pack, the Velma & Daphne Diorama, or the Chibi Pack. Check your tier before adding them: Full Collection already includes the NSFW Pack, while Complete Collection and Merchant Complete include all three. You do not need to buy an add-on again if it is already part of your reward.

faq.q: Can I sell prints or share the STL files?
faq.a: Standard rewards are for personal use. Merchant Complete includes a commercial printing licence, allowing you to sell physical prints of the models covered by that reward. The digital files themselves may not be shared, resold or redistributed, including with a Merchant reward.

faq.q: What if I have a problem with my files or downloads?
faq.a: Please send us a private message through Kickstarter. Tell us which reward or model is affected and describe the problem; a screenshot of any error is helpful. We will help you access your files and investigate any issues.
